name: insights-screen
description: Insights screen lives in MoneyStack, reached from Wallet's balance-card footer; uses balances.expenseByCategory
body: src/screens/InsightsScreen.js shows this-month income/expense/net (balances.monthTotals) and a per-category expense breakdown (balances.expenseByCategory -> sorted-desc [{category, amount, pct}]) with proportional bars scaled to the largest category and getCategoryMeta colors/icons. Registered as MoneyStack 'Insights' in AppTabs; entry point is a 'View insights' footer in WalletScreen's balance card (navigation.navigate('Insights')). No charting dependency. Covered by tests in balances.test.js.
